notes.title: We have left Early Access!

tags.feature: The Ravine is a treacherous level with its fair share of drops and new obstacles for you to overcome.
[b]Screen[/b] - Credits: are now added and accessible from menu;
[b]Audio[/b] - Added ambient sounds, effects, and an awesome soundtrack;

tags.bug: [b]Animation[/b]- Salto animation no longer freezes while landing mid salto;
[b]Animation[/b] - Double jump animation now plays when double jumping while falling;
[b]Animation[/b] - "Main menu > Temple > Main menu > Temple bug" is resolved;
[b]Sound[/b] - Sounds now play on subsequent playthroughs;
[b]Damage[/b] - Lumin no longer takes damage when invulnerable;
[b]Damage[/b] - Lumin now takes damage after invulnerability ends while in contact with a hazard;
[b]HUD[/b] - Health units no longer decease faster than actual health;
[b]Lightswitch[/b] - Light now switches on/off regardless of FPS;

tags.balance_change: [b]Fireflies[/b] - Now have a delay after being placed in a pedestal to prevent joining Lumin too quickly;

tags.bug: [b]Fireflies[/b] - Blue orb now disappears when fireflies are taken from pedestal.
